# 🌿 Welcome to Your NBS Project Preparation

I'm here to help you design and prepare your Nature-based Solutions project for Porto Alegre. We'll work through this together step-by-step, building a complete intervention profile that can be used for funding applications, partner engagement, and planning.

**📄 Document Upload Tip:** You can drop existing documents into the chat at any time — proposals, reports, plans, photos, site data, or organizational materials. I'll extract relevant information and auto-fill sections to save you time.

Let's start by getting to know your organization!
